document.title: Family psychotherapy note, Encounter HG-E119 (partner-only portion followed by patient with partner)

quotes: January 30, 2026 | In person | Clinician: Mira Patel, LCSW
Partner only: 13:00–13:15. Rowan present with partner: 13:15–13:45, 30 minutes.
Rowan joined at 13:15 and participated through the end of the session.

observations.statement: Partner described uncertainty about when reminders helped versus increased the patient's sense of pressure.
observations.quote: During the initial interval, Casey described uncertainty about when reminders helped and when they seemed to increase Rowan's sense of pressure.

observations.statement: A recurring pattern was identified in which reminders about contacting work led to lengthy discussion followed by the patient withdrawing from the task.
observations.quote: Together, they identified a recurring pattern in which a reminder about contacting work led to a lengthy discussion, followed by Rowan withdrawing from the task.

observations.statement: Patient practiced requesting a specific kind of help and naming when a reminder felt overwhelming.
observations.quote: Rowan practiced requesting a specific kind of help and naming when a reminder felt overwhelming.

observations.statement: Both participants agreed to try one brief planned check-in instead of repeated questions.
observations.quote: Both participants agreed to try one brief check-in at a planned time rather than repeated questions across the evening.

observations.statement: Patient remained anxious about the work conversation but could explain the intended first step.
observations.quote: Rowan remained anxious about the work conversation but could explain the intended first step.

observations.statement: Patient reported that having a limited plan felt more manageable.
observations.quote: The patient reported that having a limited plan felt more manageable.
